# DevHorizon Technologies

> DevHorizon Technologies Private Limited is a Bengaluru-based digital company building custom websites, mobile apps, and Meta ads campaigns for clients across India, UAE, UK, US, and Canada.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of DevHorizon's services, projects, and approach.
- [About](/about): Company story, team, mission, and core values.
- [Services](/services): Web development, mobile apps, and Meta ads management.
- [Web Development](/services/web-development): Custom, SEO-optimized website builds.
- [Mobile Apps](/services/mobile-apps): iOS and Android app development.
- [Meta Ads](/services/meta-ads): Facebook and Instagram ads management.
- [Projects](/projects): Portfolio of shipped client work.
- [Reviews](/reviews): Client testimonials and ratings.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on web, mobile, and marketing.
- [Get a Quote](/get-quote): Request a project estimate.
